source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes the MB endpoint, disables TLS and projects Manufacturer/ProductName/PartNumber but omits exact IPMI parity and PartNumber interpretation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds exact mainboard mapping, PartNumber-aware full reconciliation and read-only boundaries.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 958/2291 accepts direct execution without showing that MB is the system mainboard or which part-number namespace applies.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: HIB and MID are different boards; their part identifiers must not satisfy mainboard evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 retains original surfaces; ED-34 bounds alternate collectors; ED-35 rejects a three-property reduction; ED-36 treats mapping/PartNumber rules as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify FRU_MB represents the actual system mainboard and that its complete inventory, including the authoritative mainboard PartNumber, is consistent across WebUI, Redfish, read-only IPMI and Project build records.
original_method: Map the physical mainboard to exact API and IPMI objects, collect complete protected read-only records and WebUI detail, preserve raw part-number strings, normalize vendor encodings and compare every required field without clearing logs or writing FRU data.
manual_activity: The hardware owner binds the mainboard to management objects and defines PN versus assembly/PCB/revision fields. The agent performs collection/comparison; the engineer resolves authority conflicts and verdict.
safety_requirements: Use FRU reads only; no EEPROM edit, reset or reboot.
Prove MB identity instead of assuming a URI/default IPMI record.
Keep PartNumber, serial, product and PCB revision as separate fields.
Use trusted transport and redact sensitive identifiers.
Stop on ambiguous board or PN authority without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve one physical mainboard across API/IPMI/UI.
Normalize PN and all required fields while preserving raw values.
Compare against Project build/BOM and classify stale/missing/encoding results.
engineer_actions: Approve MB mapping and PN namespace.
Approve fields, normalization, redaction and authority.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET is partial, insecure and unbound; PartNumber alone plus two labels cannot prove mainboard identity or IPMI/UI parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the mainboard member and IPMI FRU, then compare complete protected evidence with explicit PN semantics and WebUI/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_MB, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time estimates are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform mainboard-bound complete FRU parity with PN-aware normalization.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor mainboard FRU layout and Project BOM/build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic target and PN semantics with protected complete evidence while retaining original comparisons.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three API fields do not prove full FRU or IPMI/WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: MB map, PN definition, FRU matrix and authority.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Assembly PN, PCB PN and revision may differ legitimately; cached data can be stale.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory tools require exact mainboard binding, approved PN mapping, per-field equivalence and uncovered original-interface coverage.
expected_evidence: Physical MB/BMC identity and exact API/IPMI mapping
WebUI capture, Project BOM and PN definition
Uncleared logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently targets mainboard FRU correctness; the prior three-field shortcut is an external deficiency.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mainboard parity is clear; mapping and PN rules are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores full parity and PN semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid target-dependent readiness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds mainboard and PN authority gates.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible but wrong assembly or PCB identifier from being accepted as the Project mainboard PN and binds evidence to the actual system board.
independent_technical_reasoning: PartNumber is not universally scoped: a board FRU may carry assembly, PCB or system identifiers. Correct evidence must name the expected namespace and bind it to the installed mainboard before textual equality has acceptance meaning.
